visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women stand outdoors in front of vibrant, large green banana leaves under bright natural daylight. The main character in the foreground wears a grey shirt and balances a cotton swab on her eyelashes to demonstrate their curl strength, while her friend in a beige top mimics the action behind her with a surprised expression. (2) The scene cuts to an extreme close-up of the main character's eye, focusing on the detailed texture of her lashes. A white mascara tube with ornate gold patterns is held up; the wand is pulled out to show a curved, fine-toothed comb applicator dripping with translucent primer. (3) The character is now in a bright studio-like setting with a grey background, carefully brushing the primer onto her lashes with precise upward strokes. Her facial expressions are concentrated, showing the micro-movements of her eyes and the placement of the wand against her lash line. (4) A split-screen comparison appears, labeled 'After' and 'Before', highlighting the significant lift on the left side. She then introduces a second product—a black and gold mascara tube—and demonstrates applying it over the primer, showing her lashes becoming thicker and darker. (5) The video transitions to show the character's friend, whose shorter lashes are compared in a before-and-after format against a white wall. The main character holds both tubes to the camera, gesturing toward them while speaking, her hands showing red-painted nails and silver jewelry. (6) In a final indoor scene, presumably hours later, the character is shown in softer indoor lighting. She points to her eye and successfully performs the cotton swab challenge again, proving the lashes have not drooped. She smiles warmly at the camera to conclude the demonstration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional tutorial for Majolica Majorca's lash primer and mascara. It uses a combination of the 'cotton swab challenge' to prove physical efficacy and side-by-side comparisons to showcase visual improvements, aimed at convincing viewers of the product's long-lasting curling power.
